notes.title: March Update
notes.content: Minor bug fixes. Nothing has been simplified for your enjoyment!

notes.title: v1.1.25
notes.content:
New cursor for better readability around the sausage transitioning from green to white. 
- Delivery of zucchinis and salads straight from the garden! 

I hope this will help you in your ascent. Hang in there and good luck!

- Some particle effects have been added in various locations.

notes.content:
- Optimization of hitboxes for certain objects.
- The game's timer for achievements now starts at the sausage's first jump instead of at the game scene's loading.
- We have received some high-quality garden tomatoes, enjoy!

notes.title: New update
notes.content: Minor bug fixes, Happy New Year 2024!

notes.title: Weekend Update
notes.content: The passage of the three salt shakers has been slightly modified. Some hitboxes have been revised to prevent the sausage from getting stuck. The kitchen has been stocked with fresh products. The salt still tastes great! Wishing you many hours of happiness at Slippery Heights! Have a great Sunday everyone!
